subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II access, DDQ kickoff & timeline
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moreno <alice@pulse.med>, Kyle Jensen <kyle@pulse.med>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II access, DDQ kickoff & timeline

Hi Alice / Kyle —

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate the thoughtful questions. Per our call, quick recap and next steps so we can get your security and procurement teams what they need: 

1) Documents you requested: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period), a short bridge/attestation letter if Type II is slightly older, and access to our trust portal where artifacts and evidence can be shared.
2) Questionnaire: Please find attached the vendor security questionnaire (PulseMed_VSQ_Q3_2026.pdf) you mentioned on the call. If you prefer, we can start with our streamlined DDQ (Redwood_DDQ_Template.xlsx) and/or do a quick intake call.
3) Compliance scope: Redwood supports GDPR-compliant processing and offers HIPAA controls for PHI workflows in Private/Dedicated configurations — if you plan to send PHI we’ll need to align on a BAA (we can start that in parallel).

Action items / timeline we propose: 
- Today/Tomorrow: I’ll share a Trust Portal invite (read-only) and a draft bridge letter for your legal to review.
- By EOD Thu (9/17): PulseMed to confirm which artifacts you need (full Type II report vs. summary + bridge) and whether a BAA is required.
- Week of 9/21: Redwood security to begin DDQ walk-through if helpful; portal handoff and evidence upload.

Attachments: PulseMed_VSQ_Q3_2026.pdf, Redwood_DDQ_Template.xlsx (attached for your intake)

If that timeline sounds ok I’ll kick off the portal invite and loop in Ben for the formal evidence handoff. Thanks —

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124
From: Alice Moreno <alice@pulse.med>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kyle Jensen <kyle@pulse.med>, procurement@pulse.med
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II access, DDQ kickoff & timeline

Thanks, Hannah — great recap. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- We will need the full SOC 2 Type II report if available; if not, the most recent Type II plus a bridge letter is fine.
- We are evaluating PHI flow for a pilot. We will need to confirm if Redwood’s hosted mode supports PHI or if we must go Dedicated/Private. Please call out any controls differences relevant to HIPAA.
- Procurement asked for an anticipated turnaround for the DDQ and portal evidence so they can schedule reviews — is 2 weeks realistic?

I'll confirm with legal by Friday on the BAA requirement. We appreciate you starting the portal access.

Best —
Alice Moreno
Head of IT Security, PulseMed
alice@pulse.med | +1 (617) 555-7421

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PulseMed intake — bridge letter draft + portal invite

Looping in quick notes for the handoff to PulseMed: 

- SOC 2: Our current Type II report covers 04/2025–04/2026 and we can provide the full report. If they'd prefer a short attestation/bridge for procurement purposes, see attached Draft_Bridge_Letter_Template.pdf — feel free to tailor to PulseMed.
- Portal: I generated a read-only invite scoped to the artifacts PulseMed asked for (control narratives, SOC report, configuration screenshots). Invite link: https://app.redwood.com/trust/invite?token=inv-9a2b (expires in 14 days).
- HIPAA/PHI: Hosted (shared) deployments are not turnkey for PHI without a BAA and some configuration guardrails; Dedicated or Private is the recommended path for pilot PHI. If PulseMed needs hosted + PHI we should restrict ingestion, enable customer-managed keys, and sign a BAA — timeline expands by ~2 weeks for legal + ops.
- Timeline: For a standard DDQ (20–30 Qs) plus evidence pull, 7–10 business days is typical; for a more detailed VSQ (50+ Qs) plan for ~2 weeks. Procurement’s 2-week ask is reasonable but call out any extended items (BAA, custom SOC addenda).

Next steps I recommend you send PulseMed the portal link, attach the draft bridge letter, and offer a 30-min intake with our security lead if they'd like a walkthrough. Happy to join the intake call if needed.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Hi Alice / Kyle —

Thanks for the quick replies — next practical steps below and a proposed low-friction timeline to keep procurement on schedule: 

1) Portal invite: https://app.redwood.com/trust/invite?token=inv-9a2b (read-only, artifact package: SOC2-report-2026, control-narratives, config-screens). Link expires 9/30.
2) Attached: Draft_Bridge_Letter_Template.pdf (Ben’s draft) and Redwood_DDQ_Template.xlsx. I’ve also attached PulseMed_VSQ_Q3_2026.pdf back for your reference.
3) Timeline we’ll aim for (adjust if you need faster/slower):
   - Today (9/16): Portal invite sent, draft bridge letter and DDQ attached.
   - By 9/17: PulseMed confirms whether full Type II is required or bridge + report summary is sufficient. Also confirm if BAA is needed for the pilot.
   - Week of 9/21: If confirmed, Redwood security will start evidence handoff and complete the DDQ within 7–10 business days (we’ll flag any deep-dive items).

If procurement wants an official estimate for a PO/contract then we can provide a scoped statement of work that includes any Dedicated/Private setup and estimated timeline for BAA negotiation. Would you like me to send that SOW draft to procurement as a follow-up?

Propose a 30-minute intake on Mon 9/21 at 10am ET to walk through the DDQ and portal; here’s a calendar placeholder: https://cal.com/hannah/30min (or tell me a better time).

Appreciate the partnership — I’ll stand by for your confirmation and will loop Ben into the intake call if you want a technical walkthrough.

Best,
— Hannah
